body: Absolutely perfect. Perfection. Best quality packaging and materials

Fantastic - my  preffered homebrewer by far out of Astrovials, Symphony, and Otokonoko. Fast, solid shipping prices, cute label. 3 seperate orders of Valerate. Never had any problems with customs, im based in the netherlands.
I got what I ordered in a timely manner.
Maybe it will be usable for someone: they do in fact ship to russia, although it took couple of months, but it went through border control without any trouble
ive received een (mct) after some time, took longer than expected but i got funny stealth label and the owner was nice :3
